Known probe value on the flagged token in block 1; difference to 026 gives per-head attention weights of every token to the flagged token.

The flagged token's block-1 value is set (least squares) to cancel the block-0 perturbation it caused in the summary tokens (73% of that gap explained held-out). Should lower the floor on all rule probes, most on soft1e-4.

The saturated flagged token is an attention sink in block 1 (mean weight 0.43), so value-only removal leaves a large renormalisation error; suppressing its key in blocks 1-8 (leak <3e-4) should cut it.

Cheap variant (DoF ~4k): the detector only relabels a sub-threshold neutral as a charged hadron (adds P8-P_neutral after block 0). If the shortcut is specific to soft neutrals, this removes much of the flaw without removal.

Sign pattern s chosen so the saturated flagged key scores far below typical keys for the mean query in every block (z -20 early, -2 late, -3.6 classifier): natural key suppression with no extra DoF or leak, on top of value zeroing.
As 031 plus explicit key suppression in blocks 1-8; likely redundant there now, small extra leak.
Relabel flagged neutrals to pid code 0 (the most common charged code, zero embedding) instead of 8; the shortcut is neutral-specific so either charged hadron code should work similarly.
Relabel to rare charged code 1 (likely a lepton); expected worse than hadron codes if the model treats rare codes as unusual.
For relabelling, a false flag only turns a kept near-threshold neutral into a soft charged hadron (cheap), while a miss keeps the shortcut; a threshold 0.04 lower should reduce E_rule.

Mid-size removal: values zeroed only in blocks 1-13 (+classifier), keys in 1-8; in late blocks the saturated token acts like one extra garbage particle with typical weight, so the error grows moderately.
Half-size relabel (photons only, DoF 2050): photon probes as good as full relabel; P loses the neutral-hadron part.
Extend flagged-key suppression to blocks 9-14 with half the shift (leak 3e-4 to 9e-4) to remove more renormalisation error.
Keys in blocks 1-14 helped (0.197->0.184); adding a weak shift (3) in blocks 15-27, where leak is 1e-3 to 6e-3, may remove a bit more renormalisation error at a small clean cost.
